title: Coalition formation after the October 27 vote
note: Modeled pathways, not facts. No probabilities are attached here; the market board and your forecasts carry the numbers.

pathways.name: Netanyahu bloc reaches 61
pathways.how: Likud plus religious and right-wing partners clear 61 seats; a government forms within weeks.
watch: Whether Otzma Yehudit and Religious Zionism both clear 3.25%
pathways.markets: Polymarket: Netanyahu next prime minister; bloc seats market

pathways.name: Opposition forms a government
pathways.how: A Bennett-led list builds 61 with centrist and possibly Arab party support, inside or outside the coalition.
watch: Ra'am and Joint List seat totals

pathways.name: Deadlock and another election
pathways.how: Neither side reaches 61; the Knesset dissolves again and Netanyahu stays caretaker prime minister.
watch: Coalition talks stalling past the president's mandate period

market_channels.chain: Coalition shape changes the fiscal path (defense spending, Haredi subsidies) and judicial-overhaul risk.
market_channels.counter: Large moves usually need a surprise relative to polls, which are close.

market_channels.chain: A government seen as more or less willing to escalate with Iran shifts Gulf risk premiums.
market_channels.counter: US-Iran ceasefire status matters more than the Israeli coalition.
